title: Finite scalar map equals the constant-section map
statement: For prime l, a finite extension E, n≥0 and a scheme map g:U→V, set R=finite l E (n+1). The ring-sheaf scalar map adjoint to R.pull(g) equals proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageMap g (O_E/(varpi_E^(n+1))). This follows from the specified construction of finite.pull, not from any choice of an isomorphism.

proof.text: The specified finite.pull is the inverse adjoint transpose of the constant-section scalar map. The equation is homEquiv.apply_symm_apply. It also holds for identity maps, empty schemes and zero coefficient rings.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteRingDirectImageMap_eq {U V : Scheme.{w}} (g : U ⟶ V) :
    let R := PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
    proEtaleRingDirectImageMap g (R.ring V) (R.ring U) (R.pull g) =
      proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageMap g (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))
